questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of given conclusion logically follows the given statements,

Statements:

I. Some figures are small.

II. No small is red.

Conclusions:

I. All small are figures.

II. Some red are small.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d8c25302976b6e85d46f5fda1c8190632bdce1683ed1f4fdbe46344fd4ddda0.png] 

I. All small are figures. → False (As, Some figures are small → so, some small are figures)

II. Some red are small → False (As, No small is red → no red is small)

Hence, neither conclusion (I) nor conclusion (II) follows.

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of given conclusion logically follows the given statements,

Statements:

I. Some pens are round.

II. All round are black.

Conclusions:

I. All black are pens.

II. Some round are black.

III. All round are pens.

options.text: None of the above conclusions follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4a6b5a9d3a055a33797b2298a60f85d0091a232a66ebd222f6112dd48da2b7e.png] 

I. All black are pens. → False (As, Some pens are round and All round are black → so, some black are pens)

II. Some round are black. → True (As, All round are black → so, some round are also black will be true)

III. All round are pens. → False (As, Some pens are round and All round are black → so, some round are pens)

Hence, Only conclusion (II) follows.

questions.question: The present ages of Rohit and Mohit are 48 years and 32 years respectively. What was the ratio of ages of Rohit and Mohit 12 years ago?
questions.solution:
The present ages of Rohit and Mohit are 48 years and 32 years respectively.

Age of Rohit 12 years ago = (48 – 12) = 36

Age of Mohit 12 years ago = (32 – 12 = 20

Ratio = 36 : 20

= 9 : 5

Hence, ‘9 : 5’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: A, B and C alone can do a work in 48, 12 and 24 days respectively. A, B and C together can complete two third of the same work in how many days?
questions.solution:
**Given**

A, B and C alone can do a work in 48, 12 and 24 days respectively

**Formula used**

Efficiency = Total work/Time taken

**Calculation**

Let total work be (LCM of 48, 12 and 24) 48 units.

Hence, efficiency of A = 48/48 = 1 unit/day

And, efficiency of B = 48/12 = 4 units/day

And, efficiency of C = 48/24 = 2 units/day

Now, two-third of total work = (2/3) × 48 = 32 units

Total efficiency of A, B and C = 1 + 2 + 4 = 7 units/day

∴ Time taken = 32/7 days
